Klasse ChartWindow

java.lang.Object
view.ChartWindow
public class ChartWindow extends Object
This ChartWindow represents a separate window for visualization of Live-Simulation statistic using JavaFX

It includes these three different diagrams:

  • A line diagram for the average vehicle speed over time step
  • A bar chart for the vehicle density per edge id
  • A bar chart for the distribution of vehicle travel time
Autor:
Minh Khoi

    • updateData

      public void updateData(int currentStep, double avgSpeed, Map<String,Integer> densityMap, Map<String,Integer> travelTimeMap)
      Updates the data in all diagrams

      This method uses Platform.runLater(Runnable) to make sure that the changes in UI of JavaFX Application Thread would be carried out This prevents the Threading problem, when the method was called from the Simulation Thread.

      Parameter:
      currentStep - The step of the actual simulation (used as X value in the average speed diagram)
      avgSpeed - The average speed of all vehicles in the current step
      densityMap - The map that records the number of vehicles for each edge ID The old data of the vehicle density diagram would be erased every step und refilled with new data
      travelTimeMap - The map that contains the time interval of vehicle travel time as key and number of vehicles in the interval as value Here the data would be erased every step and renewed
